svg.title: Composition of an AI Council
svg.desc: The AI Council draws members from five functions. Business leadership: strategy, vision, investment and oversight. IT and technology: architecture, infrastructure, security and integration. Legal and compliance: policies, regulations, risk management and ethics. HR and people: talent, training, change management and culture. Business functions such as finance, marketing, sales and operations: use cases, adoption, measurement and value realization.
svg.text: Cross-functional, not IT alone: each function brings its own remit.
